calculators.title: 28 Free BNBC 2020 & ACI 318 Structural Calculators
calculators.description: Twenty-eight free structural calculators to BNBC 2020 and ACI 318 — seismic, wind, drift, member design, reinforcement detailing and estimating.

calculatorGroups.title: Load Analysis
calculatorGroups.desc: Derive the seismic and wind demands on the structure before any member is sized.

items.name: Seismic Base Shear
items.desc: Equivalent static analysis to BNBC 2020. Zone coefficient by town, response spectrum Cs, design base shear and the vertical distribution of storey forces.

items.name: Wind Load — MWFRS
items.desc: Directional procedure for the main wind force resisting system. Rigid or flexible gust factor, velocity pressure profile and wall pressures.

items.name: Vertical Earthquake Effect
items.desc: Vertical seismic load effect Ev and the modified gravity combinations, by BNBC 2020 or ASCE 7-16.

items.name: Load Combination Generator
items.desc: All eight BNBC 2020 strength design combinations evaluated for one load effect, with the vertical earthquake effect folded in and the uplift case reported.

calculatorGroups.title: Code Compliance Checks
calculatorGroups.desc: Screen an analysis model against the BNBC irregularity, drift and stability provisions.

items.name: Base Shear Verification
items.desc: Reconcile the model base reaction with the code static value and obtain the scale factor when it falls short.

items.name: P-Delta Stability
items.desc: Storey stability coefficient against the code limit of 0.5/(βCd) capped at 0.25.

items.name: Drift & Sway Limitation
items.desc: Design storey drift, drift ratio and total sway against Table 6.2.21 and the H/500 serviceability limit.

items.name: Soft Storey Irregularity
items.desc: Vertical stiffness irregularity types 1a and 1b against the storey above and the average of the three above.

items.name: Torsional Irregularity
items.desc: Ratio of maximum to average storey drift with the accidental torsion amplification factor Ax.

items.name: Overturning Moment
items.desc: Overturning from storey forces or shears against the resisting moment with a factor of safety of 1.5.

calculatorGroups.title: Member Design
calculatorGroups.desc: Size and detail reinforced concrete members from first principles.

items.name: RC Beam Flexural Design
items.desc: Singly, doubly and T-beam sections with live stress block visualisation and a full calculation breakdown.

items.name: RC Column Design
items.desc: Rectangular tied or circular spiral column capacity under axial load and moment, with an interaction diagram.

items.name: Slenderness & Moment Magnifier
items.desc: Decides whether a column is short or slender, then produces the magnified design moment Mc that the column calculators take as input.

items.name: Circular Column Interaction
items.desc: P-M interaction by strain compatibility with the concrete zone integrated as a circular segment, plus the spiral ratio check.

items.name: RC Slab — Direct Design Method
items.desc: Two-way slab by the ACI direct design method with minimum thickness, punching shear and reinforcement layout.

items.name: Two-Way Slab — Coefficient Method
items.desc: Nine panel cases on stiff beams, minimum thickness from the beam stiffness ratio, and a full bar schedule.

items.name: Cantilever Slab / Balcony
items.desc: Working stress design of a projecting slab with the elastic constants j and k and the ACI L/10 minimum.

items.name: RC Stair Design
items.desc: Six support configurations solved by statics, with waist thickness, shear and reinforcement detailing.

items.name: Shear Wall Design
items.desc: Barbell wall: minimum reinforcement regime, in-plane shear strength, axial and flexural capacity and bulb confinement.

items.name: Square Footing Design
items.desc: Isolated square footing with base area, punching shear, beam shear and reinforcement mesh.

items.name: Rectangular Footing Design
items.desc: Isolated rectangular footing with L and B direction reinforcement and both shear checks.

items.name: Combined Footing Design
items.desc: Two-column footing: bearing pressure, middle-third rule, longitudinal beam analysis and punching at both columns.

calculatorGroups.title: Estimating
calculatorGroups.desc: Convert a finished design into quantities and a priced bill.

items.name: Foundation Estimating
items.desc: Earthwork, soling, RCC, shuttering, reinforcement by bar mark and mortar constituents, priced into a bill of quantities.

items.name: Beam Estimating
items.desc: Bar bending schedule with cut lengths and stirrup take-off across any number of spans, with a costed BOQ.

calculatorGroups.title: Reinforcement Detailing
calculatorGroups.desc: Turn analysis demands into buildable bar spacing and lengths.

items.name: Beam Stirrup Spacing
items.desc: Av/s demand screened against every ACI seismic detailing limit, with end zone and middle zone spacing.

items.name: Column Tie Spacing
items.desc: Confined zone tie spacing with hx, the so expression bounded 100–150 mm, and the confinement length Lo.

items.name: Shear Wall Rebar
items.desc: Vertical and horizontal curtain ratios against the minimum and the 3t, 18 in, lw/3 and lw/5 spacing limits.

items.name: Development & Splice Lengths
items.desc: Tension, compression, standard hook and Class A and B splice lengths for every metric bar size.

process.title: Brief & Feasibility
process.desc: We establish the structural brief: occupancy and loading, site and soil constraints, the governing code, and the client's cost and programme limits.

process.title: Analysis & Modelling
process.desc: An analytical model is built in ETABS or SAP2000, with load cases and combinations set out to BNBC 2020 or ASCE 7, and the results checked against hand calculations.

process.title: Design & Optimisation
process.desc: Members are sized to ACI 318 and BNBC 2020, then optimised for material efficiency and buildability rather than simply passing the check.

process.title: Documentation
process.desc: You receive construction drawings, reinforcement detailing, column and beam schedules, quantities, and a calculation report that shows the reasoning.

process.title: Construction Support
process.desc: We stay available through construction for RFIs, site queries, and design review as conditions on the ground change.
